options.text: Geographic isolation, because the species live in different places.
options.why: The two species live in the same pond, so this is not geographic isolation.

options.text: Prezygotic isolation, because the species breed at different times and so no zygotes are formed.
options.why: A barrier that prevents mating or fertilization acts before the zygote forms.

options.text: Postzygotic isolation, because the zygotes die early in development.
options.why: No zygotes are formed at all in this example.

facts: Two closely related species of frogs live in the same pond.
